name: Daraku Royal Seishojo
source:
The Tree of Life is dead and withered, and the Kingdom's holy maiden longs to be disgraced.

An unquenchable thirst for love leads the noble maiden down a slippery slope to sweet corruption. 

Drink from her flowing nectar and sow the white seeds of immorality within her womb.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1473880]Steam[/url]]
